_comment: Build-reliability benchmark (fix/build-reliability). 50 real-world prompts in Hindi, Hinglish and English across simple/medium/complex; `smoke: true` marks the 15-prompt smoke set. Run with scripts/agentv3-reliability-bench.ts — it calls a LIVE server and costs real provider money, so it refuses to run without BENCH_CONFIRM=yes.

एक कैलकुलेटर ऐप बनाओ जिसमें जोड़, घटाना, गुणा, भाग और क्लियर बटन हो
Build a notes app: create, edit, search and delete notes, saved in localStorage, with a sidebar list and an editor.
BMI calculator banao, height cm me aur weight kg me, result ke saath category bhi dikhao

Build a restaurant tip and bill splitter: bill amount, tip %, number of people, amount per person.
unit converter app chahiye - length, weight, temperature convert kare
